name: default
_what_this_is: What counts as a marked box. Edit this file, re-run, and the answers change; no code is touched. POLICY.md is the prose version of the same decisions, written by the person who labelled the gold set.
_how_to_use: make eval uses this file. To score a different one: HV_POLICY=policy-strict.json make eval. Every number published in the README was measured with this file exactly as it stands.
_rulings_note: The three decisions customers actually argue about. Each takes filled, empty, or route. All three flag the box for review either way; what changes is the boolean reported alongside. route means report the raw ink lean and let the reason code speak.
_ink_note: How much of the box interior has to be inked before it reads as selected, and the band around that number nobody should be confident inside. A box landing in the band is flagged rather than decided.
_shape_note: Shape evidence settles what ink quantity cannot. One dominant stroke crossing the box is a mark even when it is thin. Span is measured inside the 15 percent inset interior, whose own diagonal is 0.70 of the box diagonal, so 0.45 is a real crossing and a threshold of 0.7 would be unreachable by construction.
_stray_note: A stroke with at least this share of its pixels outside the box grown by a quarter is passing through the box rather than marking it. This is what separates a tick from handwriting crossing the page.
_fragment_note: Several small ink blobs with no dominant stroke: printed text sitting in a table cell, or a box that has been scribbled out. Both are cases where the control is not a plain selection.
